invariants.text: adspend.json contains the five named series (coen_mce, magna, iab_pwc, irs_soi, benchmarks_pre1919), each with a declared coverage window and points tagged with their source series.

No year+medium point exists in two series without a concordance entry covering that pair; the 1980-2007 bridge is documented with method and reproducible arithmetic; bridged/spliced points are graded C.

The IRS cross-check is computed for every year where irs_soi overlaps the assembled totals; divergence over 15% is flagged; forecast entries in forecasts.json carry per-panelist values and panel variance, with the median as headline.

The concordance entries honestly describe the definitional differences (billings vs revenue basis, category scope changes with year and magnitude). Bridge method is defensible over the actual overlap window.
invariants.instructions: Read the concordance object and dataset-notes.md. Each entry must name what differs and by how much in overlap years. A concordance entry that says 'differs' without magnitude, or a bridge estimated outside its overlap window, violates this invariant.

invariants.text: Era-record SCALE figures reconcile with adspend.json within stated CIs for the years both cover.
Points after the era-7 data-freeze date (2026-06-30) appear only in forecasts.json, never as sourced points in adspend.json.
